svg.title: First Kick AWS Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: Architecture showing user's local Next.js frontend connecting to AWS cloud backend including API Gateway, Lambda, Bedrock, DynamoDB, and Amplify/CloudFront, with Football-Data.org as external dependency.
